_comment: Every browser-storage write the site makes, with the reason it is 'strictly necessary' under ePrivacy Art. 5(3) and so owes no consent banner. cmp-no-cookies-unlisted-storage fails on any write that is not listed here. Adding an entry is a deliberate act: write the justification in the visitor's terms, not the developer's. Anything for analytics, personalisation or advertising is NOT strictly necessary, and listing it here does not make it so — it needs a consent decision instead.
_matching: `where` is the source file. `call` is the setItem call site as the scanner sees it: the literal key, or the key EXPRESSION when the key is computed. `keys` is the concrete key or key shape that reaches the browser, for a human reading this later.

writes.justification: The visitor's own tick marks on the checklist they are reading. It is the feature: without it, closing the tab throws away the work they just did. Never read by us, never sent anywhere.

The VPN-off baseline (public IP + resolver IPs) the VPN-on run is compared against. The test cannot report a leak without it, and keeping it on the device rather than on our server is the privacy-preserving option.

Remembers, for this tab only, that the page was opened inside the Incognito Browser app and whether the visitor already has Pro, so the app's own upgrade screen is used and a paying subscriber is not shown a page of upgrade asks. Session-scoped, no identifier, no profile.
